designationHistory.indexText: The Assistant Secretary of Agriculture added land utilization project TX-LU-24 in Gray County, Texas, to the list of national grasslands.

authority.citation: Order of Dec. 6, 1962, 27 F.R. 12217 (36 CFR 213.1(e)), effective Dec. 11, 1962

designationHistory.note: Signed Dec. 6, 1962 by Assistant Secretary John A. Baker; effective Dec. 11, 1962. The order lists the project by number and county only; FS-612 identifies TX-24 as McClellan Creek.
